title: Could a Former Batman Actor Become the Joker? Fans Think So!
summary:
What if Batman and the Joker switched places? In the new 'Absolute Batman' comic, that's exactly what happens! Bruce Wayne is young, angry, and loves to talk trash. He's not the quiet, scary Batman you might know. And the Joker? He's the rich one with a secret cave and his own sidekicks. Wild, right?

This comic is so popular it's becoming a cartoon. Fans are already picking dream voices for the characters. For Batman, they like actors who sound tough and young, like Aleks Le, who even made his own fan-dub online.

But the Joker is where it gets really fun. Since this Joker is basically a twisted Bruce Wayne, fans think it would be hilarious to have a former Batman actor voice him. Imagine Christian Bale—the star of the 'Dark Knight' movies—as the Joker! He once played a creepy businessman in 'American Psycho,' so he could be perfect. Another fan suggested Ben Affleck, who also played Batman.

Of course, getting a huge movie star for a cartoon might be tough. A more likely pick is Troy Baker, who has voiced both Batman and the Joker in games. But the idea of hearing Batman's voice come out of the Joker's mouth? That's the kind of weird, fun twist that makes this story so exciting.
why_it_matters: This shows how creative fans can be, and it might make you imagine what your favorite hero would sound like if a different actor played the villain.

background_read: Batman is a superhero from DC Comics who first appeared in 1939. He fights crime in Gotham City, and his greatest enemy is the Joker, a crazy clown-like villain.

Many actors have played Batman in movies. Christian Bale (the star of 'The Dark Knight' trilogy) played a haunted, serious version, while Ben Affleck (who played Batman in 'Batman v Superman') was older and angrier.
In cartoons and video games, voice actors bring these characters to life. Sometimes fans make their own 'fan-dubs' to show how they would sound as the hero.
Article_Structure: WHO: Fans of the 'Absolute Batman' comic, voice actors like Aleks Le, Christian Bale, Ben Affleck, and Troy Baker.
WHAT: Fans are excitedly choosing dream voices for a new cartoon based on the comic, with many suggesting a former Batman actor should voice the Joker because the roles are flipped.
WHERE: In online fan communities and social media discussions about the upcoming cartoon.
WHY: In this story, the Joker is a twisted version of Bruce Wayne, so hearing a familiar Batman's voice from the Joker would be a perfect, weird twist.

perspectives.description: It's a hilarious and genius idea: having a former Batman actor play the Joker would be a perfect meta-twist that fits the topsy-turvy world of the comic.
Big movie stars rarely do cartoon voices, so the job will probably go to professional voice actors like Troy Baker, who already know both characters well.
Even if they get a famous name, some fans might be disappointed if the performance doesn't match their own dream version, which could cause arguments online.
